# ResinPro Cheshire

> Family-run, Vuba-approved resin bound driveway, patio and pathway installers based in Penyffordd, North Wales. We serve Cheshire, North Wales and the wider North West.

We only install resin bound surfaces (not resin bonded). All resin products are sourced from Vuba, with a 25-year manufacturer's guarantee. We provide free on-site surveys and fixed-price quotes — no hidden fees.

## What we do

- Resin bound driveways
- Resin bound patios
- Resin bound pathways
- Driveway resurfacing (resin overlay on existing tarmac/concrete)
- Groundwork and sub-base preparation
- Decorative resin borders and edging finishes

## Pricing

- Standard rate: £150–£190 per m²
- Final price confirmed at free on-site survey
- No hidden costs — fixed quotes only

## Service areas

Cheshire, Chester (CH1–CH4), Warrington (WA1–WA16), Wilmslow (SK9), Knutsford (WA16), Northwich (CW8–CW9), Altrincham (WA14–WA15), North Wales, Wrexham, Penyffordd

## About

ResinPro Cheshire is a Vuba-approved installer. We are based in Penyffordd, Flintshire, and travel across Cheshire and North Wales. We use exclusively Vuba resin products backed by a 25-year manufacturer's guarantee and our own workmanship guarantee.
